Aatrox.watch: Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade deals his main damage and knocks you airborne. Watch the cast and dodge by moving outside the blade’s tip range or inside it. If Aatrox W Infernal Chains hits you, walk out of its area immediately, and save Gangplank W Remove Scurvy for the pull. When Aatrox R World Ender is active, his healing increases, so don’t take the duel; create distance.
Aatrox.build: Build armor first to withstand the physical damage from Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains. Since Aatrox’s armor makes Gangplank’s physical damage less effective, add penetration. If the duel is prolonged, get healing reduction.
Aatrox.fight: Look to trade right after Aatrox uses the empowered basic attack from Aatrox P Deathbringer Stance on a minion. While dodging the tip of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade, slow him with a Gangplank E Powder Keg that you have placed and allowed to age in advance, then follow up. If Aatrox R World Ender is active, create distance and wait for it to expire.
Aatrox.laning: Focus on not giving up a kill early. If you’re behind, don’t push the wave; last-hit with Gangplank Q Parrrley in front of your turret. Place Gangplank E Powder Keg where you plan to fight and let it age in advance, and don’t spam it alongside Gangplank Q Parrrley until you run out of mana.
Aatrox.combo: Place a Gangplank E Powder Keg behind or beside Aatrox in advance and let it age. Use the reset on Gangplank P Trial by Fire and the movement speed increase after destroying a keg to aid your next move.
Aatrox.escape: The moment after you force Aatrox to use Aatrox E Umbral Dash is your chance to close the distance. If Aatrox W Infernal Chains is also down, trade during the window when you’re less likely to be caught. Don’t rush into a duel during this window if Aatrox R World Ender is active.
Aatrox.phase: Use your keg range and artillery in the late game as well. If you didn’t give Aatrox kills early, the matchup improves as the game goes on.
Aatrox.teamfight: Don’t stand in front. Prepare a Gangplank E Powder Keg beside where Aatrox’s team is likely to position, then detonate it from behind with Gangplank Q Parrrley. Layer Gangplank R Cannon Barrage to block both the enemy’s retreat path and the area around the keg. Before going in yourself, check whether the enemy’s key crowd control abilities are down. If the opening is uncertain, use a keg only to slow them, then back off.

Aurora.watch: If Aurora Q Twofold Hex hits you, move out of the line connecting you and Aurora to dodge the returning damage. The return damage increases as your health gets lower, so don’t stay under the curse. Decide whether to retreat before Aurora R Between Worlds appears or fight inside its area.
Aurora.build: Build magic resistance first against Aurora’s main damage. Aurora P Spirit Abjuration deals damage based on your maximum health, so prioritize magic resistance and movement speed rather than simply stacking large amounts of health alone.
Aurora.fight: Then get close and apply Gangplank P Trial by Fire with a basic attack. Aurora has relatively low armor, so Gangplank’s physical damage is effective.
Aurora.laning: Place a Gangplank E Powder Keg where you plan to fight and let it age in advance, and don’t spam Gangplank Q Parrrley and E Powder Keg together until you run out of mana. If Aurora Q Twofold Hex hits you while your health is low, retreat before she recalls it.
Aurora.combo: Place a Gangplank E Powder Keg beside or behind where Aurora is likely to move in advance and let it age. Destroying a keg resets Gangplank P Trial by Fire’s cooldown and grants movement speed, which also helps you pursue her.
Aurora.escape: Engage when both Aurora W Across the Veil and Aurora E The Weirding are down. If Aurora uses Aurora W Across the Veil to become invisible, don’t rush to use a targeted attack; place a Gangplank E Powder Keg where she is likely to arrive.
Aurora.phase: Early on, Gangplank has little time to let his kegs age, so avoid losses and focus on farming. Use your E Powder Keg range and artillery in the late game as well.
Aurora.teamfight: Don’t stand in front. Prepare a Gangplank E Powder Keg beside where Aurora may engage or where her team is likely to position, then detonate it from behind. Layer Gangplank R Cannon Barrage to maintain the slow and block their retreat. If no one dies after Aurora dives in, use that moment as an opportunity. Don’t leave low-health allies behind.

Akali.watch: Once marked, the second dash follows you even if you try to escape. If Akali hides in Akali W Twilight Shroud, aim for the position briefly revealed when she enters.
Akali.build: Build magic resistance first against Akali’s main damage, and get health as well. The second hit of Akali R Perfect Execution deals more damage based on your missing health, so your total health matters. Get movement speed so you can move out of telegraphed attack areas.
Akali.fight: Detonate a Gangplank E Powder Keg that you have allowed to age with Gangplank Q Parrrley to apply a slow before closing in. If Akali W Twilight Shroud is still available, don’t force a chase into it.
Akali.laning: Prepare a keg where you plan to fight, and don’t spam kegs and Q together until you run out of mana.
Akali.combo: Place a Gangplank E Powder Keg behind or beside Akali in advance and let it age. Detonate it with Gangplank Q Parrrley to slow her, then apply Gangplank P Trial by Fire with a melee basic attack if you can get close. If you’ve linked a keg farther away, use the chain explosion to extend your reach and slow.
Akali.escape: Check that both Akali W Twilight Shroud and Akali R Perfect Execution are down before going in. If Akali Q Five Point Strike slows you, you can cleanse it with Gangplank W Remove Scurvy, but using W early leaves you unable to deal with crowd control that follows.
Akali.phase: From mid game onward, Gangplank’s keg combos become strong, and Gangplank R Cannon Barrage lets him affect other lanes. Use your keg range and artillery in the late game, while watching for Akali R Perfect Execution’s engage.
Akali.teamfight: Don’t stand in front. Prepare a Gangplank E Powder Keg beside where Akali and the enemy team are likely to position. Detonate it from behind with Gangplank Q Parrrley to slow them, then layer Gangplank R Cannon Barrage to block their retreat. When Akali engages, use Gangplank W Remove Scurvy immediately after you are hit by a crowd control effect.

Camille.watch: Camille E Hookshot uses walls to engage from a long distance and stun you, so stand away from walls and avoid getting pushed toward one. Camille uses Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum after getting close, so focus on avoiding her initial engage.
Camille.build: Build armor first against Camille’s main damage. However, armor can’t reduce the true damage from Camille Q Precision Protocol, and stacking health alone also increases the maximum-health-based damage from Camille W Tactical Sweep.
Camille.fight: Avoid trading just after Camille P Adaptive Defenses grants her a shield; fight after the shield has been removed. If Camille E Hookshot stuns you, cleanse it with Gangplank W Remove Scurvy to interrupt her combo.
Camille.laning: Stand away from walls and among your minions. If you’re behind, don’t push the wave; last-hit with Gangplank Q Parrrley in front of your turret. Before Camille completes her first core item, pressure her farming when you have time to prepare a keg, but save enough mana for your keg and Q.
Camille.combo: Place a Gangplank E Powder Keg behind or beside where Camille is likely to position in advance and let it age. Gangplank P Trial by Fire applies only with melee basic attacks, and destroying a keg resets its cooldown.
Camille.escape: Engage after Camille E Hookshot’s stun is down and Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum is unavailable. If only E is down, she can re-engage with R, so keep your distance. If Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum traps you, endure it until the area ends, then counterattack.
Camille.phase: Gangplank’s keg range and artillery remain effective in the late game, so don’t let Camille take side-lane turrets quickly without contest.
Camille.teamfight: Don’t stand in front. Prepare a Gangplank E Powder Keg beside where Camille and the rest of the enemy team are likely to position. Detonate it from behind with Gangplank Q Parrrley to slow them, and block their escape with Gangplank R Cannon Barrage. Go in yourself only after key engage tools such as Camille E Hookshot are down.

Chogath.watch: When Cho'Gath Q Rupture telegraphs beneath you, immediately walk to the side to dodge it. If Cho'Gath W Feral Scream silences you, it is difficult to dodge the follow-up Q, so do not start a trade head-on. If your health is at or below half, move out of range of Cho'Gath R Feast, which deals true damage. Keep even more distance once he has stacks.
Chogath.build: Build magic resistance first against the damage from Cho'Gath Q Rupture, W Feral Scream, and E Vorpal Spikes. Cho'Gath R Feast deals true damage that resistances cannot reduce, and stacking large amounts of health alone also increases the max-health-based damage from Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes. Consider tenacity as well, since Gangplank has no mobility ability.
Chogath.fight: Place Gangplank E Powder Keg in advance and let it age, and only look for follow-up damage after its explosion slows Cho'Gath. An opening comes after you dodge Cho'Gath Q Rupture and Cho'Gath W Feral Scream is on cooldown. Cho'Gath cannot create distance on his own, but Gangplank also has no skill to escape, so do not engage while his key abilities are available.
Chogath.combo: Place Gangplank E Powder Keg behind or beside the opponent in advance and let it age. Detonate the keg in front with Gangplank Q Parrrley to chain the explosions and apply a slow. Then follow up with Gangplank Q Parrrley or a basic attack, and land a melee basic attack to use Gangplank P Trial by Fire. Do not close in before detonating the keg or use Q on a keg that has not aged enough.
Chogath.escape: Engage after Cho'Gath Q Rupture and W Feral Scream are on cooldown. Cho'Gath has no mobility ability, but Gangplank also has no skill to escape on his own, so watch your distance as you go in. If Cho'Gath crowd-controls you, break it with Gangplank W Remove Scurvy, then use the movement speed from detonating E Powder Keg to create distance.
Chogath.phase: Gangplank's kegs and artillery remain effective in the late game, but Cho'Gath gets stronger as he gains stacks, so it is important to slow his growth early and avoid giving him kills.
Chogath.laning: Stand off the line where Cho'Gath basic attacks so Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes does not hit you through minions. Once a keg combo is possible, pressure Cho'Gath to slow his growth. Treat the moment after Cho'Gath Q Rupture is used on the wave as a gank opportunity.
Chogath.teamfight: Do not stand in front. Set up Gangplank E Powder Keg beside where Cho'Gath can stand, then detonate it from behind with Gangplank Q Parrrley to slow him. Layer Gangplank R Cannon Barrage to block Cho'Gath's retreat. Before going in yourself, check whether Cho'Gath Q Rupture and W Feral Scream are down. If the opening is uncertain, just detonate the keg and back off.

Fiora.watch: Fiora Q Lunge dashes toward a vital, so stand opposite the vital to narrow her approach angle. While Fiora W Riposte is available, it can block Gangplank E Powder Keg's explosion and follow-up attacks, so bait out Riposte, move to the side, and avoid her counterattack. If Fiora R Grand Challenge targets you, stand against a wall to block one side's vital.
Fiora.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Fiora Q Lunge and E Bladework. If the duel goes on, consider anti-healing after getting resistances. Armor does not work against the true damage from Fiora P Duelist's Dance and R Grand Challenge, and be careful about stacking only health because R deals damage based on your max health.
Fiora.fight: Trade after Fiora Q Lunge and W Riposte are on cooldown. After countering Fiora's approach to a vital, do not overextend to chase her.
Fiora.laning: Place E Powder Keg in the area where you plan to fight, then stand opposite the vital and wait for Fiora Q Lunge to engage. Decide how many kegs to use for trades so you do not run out of mana by spamming keg-and-Q combos.
Fiora.combo: Place Gangplank E Powder Keg behind or beside the opponent in advance and let it arm. Use the reset passive and movement speed gained by destroying the keg to make a short trade.
Fiora.escape: The moment after you make Fiora use Q Lunge is an opportunity to close the distance and engage. If Fiora W Riposte is also on cooldown, slow her with a prepared Gangplank E Powder Keg and go in. If Riposte slows you, cleanse it with Gangplank W Remove Scurvy and manage your distance.
Fiora.teamfight: Overlap Gangplank R Cannon Barrage to block her retreat, and look to go in directly after key abilities such as Fiora W Riposte are on cooldown. If Fiora R Grand Challenge targets you, stand against a wall so you do not expose all four vitals.

Darius.watch: If Darius E Apprehend pulls you in, Darius W Crippling Strike and Darius Q Decimate follow, so harass from outside Apprehend's range. If you are pulled, cleanse the crowd control with Gangplank W Remove Scurvy and create distance. If Darius P Hemorrhage stacks build up or your health is low enough to be killed by Darius R Noxian Guillotine, end the fight and get out of range.
Darius.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Darius P Hemorrhage, Q Decimate, and W Crippling Strike. Account for the penetration from Darius E Apprehend, and use your total health to prepare for Darius R Noxian Guillotine, which armor cannot block. Include penetration in your damage options to deal with Darius's high armor.
Darius.fight: Trade briefly only when Darius E Apprehend misses or is on cooldown. The moment after Darius uses Q Decimate to clear minions is also an opportunity to harass. Before Darius P Hemorrhage stacks build up, use the slow from Gangplank E Powder Keg and the movement speed from Gangplank P Trial by Fire to disengage.
Darius.laning: Early on, stay outside Darius E Apprehend's range and safely last-hit with Gangplank Q Parrrley. Place Gangplank E Powder Keg in the area where you plan to fight and let it arm, and save mana for your kegs and Gangplank Q Parrrley. Avoid chaotic early skirmishes with Darius and fights where the enemy jungler joins.
Darius.combo: Then, when you can get close, apply Gangplank P Trial by Fire with a melee basic attack and back away before bleed stacks build up. If you placed kegs in a chain, use the chained explosions to extend your reach and slow area.
Darius.escape: Engage when Darius E Apprehend misses or is on cooldown. The window while Darius R Noxian Guillotine is on cooldown is also an opportunity, but immediately create distance if Darius P Hemorrhage stacks build up. If Darius W Crippling Strike slows you, save Gangplank W Remove Scurvy to cleanse the crowd control.
Darius.phase: In the late game, use your kegs' reach and artillery, but avoid long fights that let Darius P Hemorrhage stacks build up.
Darius.teamfight: Overlap Gangplank R Cannon Barrage to block Darius's retreat. If Darius kills you with R Noxian Guillotine while several stacks of Darius P Hemorrhage remain, his ultimate may reset, so disengage completely when things get dangerous.

Garen.watch: Garen Q Decisive Strike increases his movement speed as he approaches, then silences you with an empowered basic attack to prevent a counterattack, so do not engage first while it is active. The longer you stay in range of Garen E Judgment, the more you lose. Right after Garen activates W Courage, its shield and tenacity mean you should delay the E Powder Keg explosion by half a beat. If your health is below half, stay out of range of Garen R Demacian Justice, which deals true damage based on your missing health.
Garen.build: Build armor first against Garen's main damage sources, Garen Q Decisive Strike and E Judgment. However, Garen E Judgment reduces armor, and resistance cannot reduce the true damage from Garen R Demacian Justice, so do not stay in the spin area or execution range relying on your resistances.
Garen.fight: Trade briefly right after Garen's empowered basic attack from Q Decisive Strike is used on a minion or is otherwise spent. Detonate a pre-armed Gangplank E Powder Keg with Gangplank Q Parrrley to slow him, follow up with more damage, and get away before Garen E Judgment hits you for long. If Garen Q Decisive Strike silences you, cleanse it with Gangplank W Remove Scurvy and create distance.
Garen.laning: Once you can combo kegs, pressure Garen during the window after Garen Q Decisive Strike is used to limit the space where he can build Garen W Courage's growth stacks. Decide in advance how many kegs to use for trades so you do not run out of mana by spamming keg-and-Q combos.
Garen.combo: Place Gangplank E Powder Keg behind or beside the opponent in advance and let it arm. Once Garen's empowered basic attack from Q Decisive Strike has been consumed or expired, detonate it with Gangplank Q Parrrley to slow him. Follow up with Gangplank Q Parrrley or a basic attack, but delay the explosion by half a beat if Garen has just activated W Courage. When chaining E Powder Keg explosions, aim to extend your range and maintain the slow, not to stack damage.
Garen.phase: Gangplank's keg range and artillery remain effective in the late game, but Garen W Courage's growth stacks are permanent, so pressure him as soon as you can.
Garen.teamfight: Do not stand in front. Place Gangplank E Powder Keg beside where the enemy team is likely to stand, then detonate it from behind with Gangplank Q Parrrley to apply an area slow. Overlap Gangplank R Cannon Barrage to block both the enemy's retreat and the space around your keg. Do not force an engage, mindful of the silence from Garen Q Decisive Strike and the damage over time from Garen E Judgment, and stay out of Garen R Demacian Justice's range when your health is low.
Garen.escape: The window to approach is after Garen's empowered basic attack from Q Decisive Strike is spent; do not close in while it is active. While Garen E Judgment is in range, do not extend the fight. Use the slow from Gangplank E Powder Keg to create distance.

DrMundo.watch: Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw slows the first target it hits and also provides healing, so dodge it with minions between you. Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma increases his attack damage and empowers his basic attacks, so don’t fight him up close for too long. If Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is active, stop chasing and account for its healing and movement speed increase.
DrMundo.build: Build armor first to mitigate the physical damage from Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma. Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper deal magic damage, so armor won’t block them. If the fight is likely to drag on, build resistances before considering Grievous Wounds.
DrMundo.fight: Place Gangplank E Powder Keg in advance and let it age, then detonate it to slow Dr. Mundo before following up. Close the distance after Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw is on cooldown, but don’t fight for too long trying to kill him while Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is active. If Dr. Mundo has a dropped canister nearby, step on it as you retreat to deny his healing and passive cooldown reduction.
DrMundo.laning: Dodge Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw by keeping minions between you, and place Gangplank E Powder Keg in advance where you plan to fight. Save mana so you don’t spam your kegs and Q at the same time.
DrMundo.combo: Detonate a primed Gangplank E Powder Keg with Gangplank Q Parrrley to slow Dr. Mundo first. Follow up with Q or a basic attack, and use the true damage from Gangplank P Trial by Fire when you can land a melee basic attack. Detonating kegs in succession resets your passive’s cooldown and grants movement speed, letting you chase or retreat.
DrMundo.escape: Dr. Mundo has no skill that lets him create distance on his own, so after Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw is used, slow him with Gangplank E Powder Keg and then close in.
DrMundo.phase: Keep using your keg range and artillery in the late game, but don’t spend time on Dr. Mundo while Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is active.
DrMundo.teamfight: Don’t stand in front. Place Gangplank E Powder Keg beside where the enemy will stand, then detonate it from behind. Overlap it with Gangplank R Cannon Barrage to slow Dr. Mundo’s path and the enemy team’s retreat route. When going in yourself, wait until the enemy’s key targeted abilities are on cooldown.

Gnar.watch: Watch for the slow from Gnar Q Boomerang Throw / Boulder Toss, and dodge Mini Gnar’s boomerang on its return path too. If Mega Gnar is nearby, don’t put your back to a wall. If Gnar R GNAR! knocks you into a wall, you’ll be stunned, so use Gangplank W Remove Scurvy immediately afterward to remove the crowd control.
Gnar.build: Build armor first against Gnar Q Boomerang Throw / Boulder Toss, Gnar E Hop / Crunch, and Gnar R GNAR!. Gnar W Hyper / Wallop deals damage that armor can’t block and scales with your maximum health, so think carefully before stacking large amounts of health alone. If it’s hard to avoid the stun from Gnar R GNAR! near a wall, prioritize Tenacity as well.
Gnar.fight: Avoid fighting head-on when Gnar’s Rage is high and his transformation is near, then look for an opening just after Mega Gnar ends and he returns to Mini Gnar. After Gnar E Hop / Crunch is used, his mobility is on cooldown, so slow him with a primed Gangplank E Powder Keg and close the distance. Apply the true damage from Gangplank P Trial by Fire with a melee basic attack.
Gnar.laning: If Mini Gnar’s ranged harass is difficult to handle, farm near your turret and move out of the boomerang’s path both ways. Don’t spam Gangplank Q Parrrley and Gangplank E Powder Keg together; save mana to respond to Gnar E Hop / Crunch.
Gnar.combo: Place Gangplank E Powder Keg beside or behind where Gnar will retreat, and prime it enough to detonate in one hit. Detonate it with Gangplank Q Parrrley to slow him, then follow up with attacks. If you can get close, apply Gangplank P Trial by Fire with a melee basic attack. If you’ve chained kegs, detonate the front keg to link the explosion to the one behind it, extending its reach and slow area.
Gnar.escape: The moment after Gnar E Hop / Crunch is used is your chance to close the distance. Just after Mega Gnar ends and he returns to Mini Gnar, he can’t transform again for a while, so use the slow from Gangplank E Powder Keg to create an opening to engage. If you need to be ready for Gnar R GNAR!, don’t use Gangplank W Remove Scurvy in advance.
Gnar.phase: Your keg range and artillery remain powerful in the late game, so decide when to fight based on Gnar’s transformation cycle and whether Gnar E Hop / Crunch has been used.
Gnar.teamfight: Avoid angles where Gnar R GNAR! can knock you into a wall, and don’t face him head-on in narrow terrain. Place Gangplank E Powder Keg beside the enemy team in advance and detonate it from behind with Gangplank Q Parrrley to slow them. Overlap Gangplank R Cannon Barrage to block Gnar and his team’s retreat route. Just after Mega Gnar ends and he returns to Mini Gnar, start a fight with your allies.

Illaoi.watch: Illaoi E Test of Spirit slows and marks you, so last-hit from outside its range and dodge when it comes out. If your spirit is pulled, fight back when you can; if the fight looks unfavorable, break the tether and then dodge the first tentacle. When Illaoi R Leap of Faith is active, don’t fight near tentacles; keep your distance for its duration.
Illaoi.build: Build armor first against Illaoi’s main damage. Illaoi W Harsh Lesson deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid stacking health alone. If you need to reduce her healing, build Executioner's Calling first, then judge whether you can kill her.
Illaoi.laning: Don’t push the lane early; safely last-hit with Gangplank Q Parrrley. Keep the lane away from the walls and farm outside Illaoi E Test of Spirit’s range. Decide how many kegs to save for fights, and conserve mana so you don’t spam kegs and Q together.
Illaoi.combo: Place Gangplank E Powder Keg behind or beside the enemy in advance and wait until it’s primed enough to detonate in one hit. If you have an opening for a melee basic attack, use Gangplank P Trial by Fire, then use the passive reset and movement speed from detonating the keg to reposition.
Illaoi.escape: Look for an opening to engage right after Illaoi W Harsh Lesson is used. If you also dodge Illaoi E Test of Spirit, close the distance with the slow from Gangplank E Powder Keg.
Illaoi.phase: Keep using your keg range and artillery in the late game, but don’t fight in tentacle areas while Illaoi R Leap of Faith is active.
Illaoi.teamfight: Avoid walls with many tentacles and draw Illaoi into open ground. Don’t group up when Illaoi R Leap of Faith is used. From behind, detonate Gangplank E Powder Keg with Q to slow the enemy, placing it beside where they will stand in advance. Overlap Gangplank R Cannon Barrage to block their retreat. While Illaoi’s ultimate is active, spread out and don’t give her a target to attack.
Illaoi.fight: The moment after Illaoi uses W Harsh Lesson is your chance to close the distance. If Illaoi R Leap of Faith is active, do not keep fighting near her tentacles.

Jax.watch: Watch out for Jax Q Leap Strike closing the distance before Jax E Counter Strike goes for an area stun. When Jax E Counter Strike is active, stop basic attacking and move outside its stun radius.
Jax.build: Jax’s basic attacks and attack speed are the core of his damage, so build a defensive option that reduces attack speed first. Jax Q Leap Strike deals physical damage, while Jax W Empower and Jax E Counter Strike deal magic damage, so don’t focus on just one type of resistance. Jax E Counter Strike deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid stacking health alone.
Jax.fight: Look to trade after Jax has finished using E Counter Strike. Detonate a primed Gangplank E Powder Keg to slow him, then follow up. If Jax E Counter Strike is active, don’t try to land a melee basic attack; create distance instead.
Jax.laning: Safely last-hit with Gangplank Q Parrrley, and trade after Jax has finished using E Counter Strike. Manage your mana so you don’t run out by spamming kegs and Gangplank Q Parrrley.
Jax.phase: Gangplank E Powder Keg combos become powerful starting in the mid game, and you can keep using your keg range and artillery in the late game.
Jax.teamfight: When Jax comes in with Jax E Counter Strike active, don’t group nearby; move outside its stun radius. Overlap Gangplank R Cannon Barrage over your keg position and the enemy’s retreat route to block their movement.
Jax.combo: Set up Gangplank E Powder Keg behind or beside where Jax is likely to arrive, and let its health drop until one hit can detonate it. If Jax E Counter Strike is active, hold your basic attacks and use the movement speed from the keg explosion to get out of stun range.
Jax.escape: The moment after Jax uses Q Leap Strike is your chance to manage the distance. After Jax E Counter Strike is down, slow him with Gangplank E Powder Keg and engage. If you are stunned by Jax E Counter Strike, cleanse it with Gangplank W Remove Scurvy and disengage.

Irelia.watch: Irelia can dash to low-health minions with Irelia Q Bladesurge, so step back as a minion is about to die. If Irelia E Flawless Duet stuns you, cleanse it with Gangplank W Remove Scurvy to interrupt her combo. If you are trapped by Irelia R Vanguard's Edge, wait until the blades disappear.
Irelia.fight: Use the moment after Irelia Q Bladesurge is used as an opportunity to trade. Save Gangplank W Remove Scurvy to use if you are caught by Irelia E Flawless Duet.
Irelia.laning: Watch that no low-health minions are left between Gangplank and Irelia, and keep your distance when a minion is about to die. Early on, safely last-hit with Gangplank Q Parrrley and hold your ground without pushing the lane. Don't spam kegs and Q together; save kegs for trades and mana for farming.
Irelia.escape: The moment after you force Irelia to use Q Bladesurge is your window to close the distance. If Irelia E Flawless Duet is also down, you need not worry about the stun; slow her with a pre-primed Gangplank E Powder Keg, then engage. Be cautious if Gangplank W Remove Scurvy has already been used, since you won't be able to cleanse new crowd control.
Irelia.phase: Even late game, make use of your keg range and artillery.
Irelia.teamfight: Watch for Irelia's engage and don't stand in front. Set up Gangplank E Powder Keg beside where Irelia can stand. Detonate it from behind with Gangplank Q Parrrley to slow her, then layer Gangplank R Cannon Barrage to block off her path. Irelia R Vanguard's Edge and Irelia E Flawless Duet can dominate a team fight, so prioritize targeting her.
Irelia.combo: Set up Gangplank E Powder Keg beside or behind where Irelia can move, and let its health tick down. Use the movement speed gained and Gangplank P Trial by Fire, refreshed by destroying the keg, for the follow-up chase or disengage.

Gwen.build: Gwen W Hallowed Mist increases her armor, and Gangplank's main damage is physical, so include armor penetration in your build. Build magic resistance first against Gwen's main damage, and get armor too if her basic attack damage is a problem. Gwen P A Thousand Cuts and Gwen R Needlework scale with maximum health, so don't stack too much health alone.
Gwen.fight: Before Gwen Q Snip Snip! stacks up, poke with Gangplank Q Parrrley and stay outside basic attack range. Right after you make Gwen use E Skip 'n Slash, detonate a Gangplank E Powder Keg that you have allowed to age in advance to slow her and trade. If you are about to be hit by Gwen Q Snip Snip!, move sideways out of its center.
Gwen.laning: Gwen E Skip 'n Slash is easier to recast if it hits a minion, so don't chase her through a large wave. Don't spam Gangplank E Powder Keg and Gangplank Q Parrrley together; save mana for farming after the trade.
Gwen.combo: Set up Gangplank E Powder Keg behind or to the side of Gwen and prime it so it can be detonated in one hit. Then apply Gangplank P Trial by Fire with a basic attack when you have enough range.
Gwen.escape: The moment after you make Gwen use E Skip 'n Slash is your window to close the distance and fight. If Gwen R Needlework slows you, cleanse it with Gangplank W Remove Scurvy and reposition. If destroying a Gangplank E Powder Keg grants you the movement speed increase from Gangplank P Trial by Fire, use it to chase or disengage.
Gwen.phase: Even late game, fight from behind using your keg range and artillery.
Gwen.teamfight: Layer Gangplank R Cannon Barrage to block Gwen's retreat. Don't force an approach before Gwen E Skip 'n Slash is down, and stay out of the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!.
Gwen.watch: The center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!'s cone deals true damage, so move sideways out of the center. When Gwen W Hallowed Mist is active, you cannot target her from outside the mist, so wait for it to end before using Gangplank Q Parrrley. Gwen can approach with E Skip 'n Slash and follow with an empowered basic attack, so stay outside her basic attack range.

Jayce.watch: In cannon stance, when Jayce sets up Jayce E Thundering Blow / Acceleration Gate, Jayce Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast may follow, so immediately sidestep out of the line. In hammer stance, watch for the leap from Jayce Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast and the knockback from Jayce E Thundering Blow / Acceleration Gate. Don't use Gangplank W Remove Scurvy prematurely merely because health has decreased; use it after being affected by a disabling effect.
Jayce.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Jayce W Lightning Field / Hyper Charge and Jayce E Thundering Blow / Acceleration Gate. Magic resistance does not block the physical damage from Jayce Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast, and Jayce E Thundering Blow / Acceleration Gate deals damage based on maximum health, so be careful about stacking health alone. Also get movement speed to escape telegraphed attack areas.
Jayce.fight: Instead of trying to withstand Jayce's early strength head-on, fight from a spot where you've pre-primed Gangplank E Powder Keg. Once the leap from Jayce Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast is down, detonate a keg to slow him and close the distance. Use Gangplank P Trial by Fire when you can land a melee basic attack, and keep watching for the knockback from Jayce E Thundering Blow / Acceleration Gate.
Jayce.laning: Early on, safely last-hit with Gangplank Q Parrrley and hold your ground without pushing the lane. Move side to side to avoid Jayce's cannon poke, and leave the line as soon as you see E Acceleration Gate. Don't spam Gangplank E Powder Keg and Gangplank Q Parrrley together; save mana for trades.
Jayce.combo: Set up Gangplank E Powder Keg beside or behind where Jayce can stand and prime it so it can be detonated in one hit. Detonate the front keg with Gangplank Q Parrrley to use the chain explosion's range and slow, then add damage with a basic attack. Gangplank P Trial by Fire applies on a melee basic attack, and destroying a keg resets its cooldown.
Jayce.escape: The moment after you force Jayce to use the leap from Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast is your chance to close the distance. If the knockback from Jayce E Thundering Blow / Acceleration Gate is also down, slow him with Gangplank E Powder Keg and engage. If the knockback is still available, don't approach first; use kegs to control the distance.
Jayce.phase: Jayce is strong early, and Gangplank has little time to prime kegs, so farm defensively. Even late game, use your keg range and artillery to make up for early losses.
Jayce.teamfight: Don't stand in front. Set up Gangplank E Powder Keg beside where the enemy team, including Jayce, can stand, then detonate it from behind with Gangplank Q Parrrley. Layer Gangplank R Cannon Barrage to block the enemy's retreat and keep them slowed. Look to engage when Jayce's leap from Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast is down and he has no mobility.

Kayle.watch: Avoid a direct hit from Kayle Q Radiant Blast, which slows and reduces armor and magic resistance. When your health is low, watch out for Kayle E Starfire Spellblade, which deals damage based on your missing health. Don’t pour damage into Kayle while Kayle R Divine Judgment is active; attack after its invulnerability ends.
Kayle.build: Get magic resistance and movement speed to handle Kayle’s damage. A hit from Kayle Q Radiant Blast lowers magic resistance, so avoid a direct hit and prioritize movement speed that lets you leave the area Kayle is attacking from.
Kayle.fight: If Kayle has already used Kayle R Divine Judgment, fight more aggressively.
Kayle.laning: Watch your mana when using Gangplank Q Parrrley, and spend it where you need it for poke or last-hits.
Kayle.combo: Pre-place Gangplank E Powder Keg behind or beside Kayle and let it prime long enough to detonate in one hit, then explode it with Gangplank Q Parrrley. When chaining kegs, extend your reach and slow zone rather than trying to make the damage overlap.
Kayle.escape: Kayle has no separate mobility ability, so look to engage when the slow from Gangplank E Powder Keg connects. Kayle can use Kayle W Celestial Blessing to gain movement speed and escape, so when engaging with your jungler, coordinate for an ally’s immobilizing crowd control to land first. The moment after Kayle uses Kayle R Divine Judgment is also an opportunity to fight.
Kayle.phase: In the mid game, use Gangplank’s keg combos and Gangplank R Cannon Barrage to affect fights and other lanes.
Kayle.teamfight: Do not stand in front. Set up Gangplank E Powder Keg beside where the opponent can stand, then detonate it from behind. Layer Gangplank R Cannon Barrage to limit Kayle's position and escape route. Slows still work during Kayle R Divine Judgment's invulnerability, so coordinate with your allies' crowd control to let the invulnerability run out, then focus your damage on Kayle.

Kled.watch: If you are caught by Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope, create distance before it pulls you in. When Kled W Violent Tendencies activates, back off so you don’t get hit by the fourth attack. If Kled E Jousting and R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! are available, watch for a chain of dashes.
Kled.build: Build armor first against the main damage from Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope, W Violent Tendencies, and E Jousting. Gangplank has no ability to escape on his own, so also consider Tenacity to avoid being locked down by crowd control. Kled W Violent Tendencies and R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! deal damage based on your maximum health, so avoid relying on stacking health.
Kled.fight: Don’t engage just because Kled E Jousting is down; look for a window when Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! is also unavailable. Slow him with a pre-primed Gangplank E Powder Keg and follow up. If Kled W Violent Tendencies activates, back off before its fourth basic attack hits you.
Kled.laning: Early on, last-hit safely with Gangplank Q Parrrley in front of your turret instead of pushing the lane. Pre-prime Gangplank E Powder Keg where you plan to fight, and don’t run out of mana by spamming it with Q. If Kled has dismounted Skaarl, watch his courage meter. If you can’t finish him, create distance and keep him from attacking minions comfortably.
Kled.combo: Pre-place Gangplank E Powder Keg behind or beside the enemy and let it prime, then detonate it with Gangplank Q Parrrley to slow them first. Follow up with Q or basic attacks, but Gangplank P Trial by Fire applies only to melee basic attacks, so use it when you can get close enough to land one. Chaining keg explosions extends your reach and slow zone instead of making the damage overlap.
Kled.escape: If caught by Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope, create distance before it pulls you in, then use Gangplank W Remove Scurvy as soon as you are actually affected by its crowd control. Engage after Kled E Jousting and R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! are down, especially before R comes back up. When retreating, use the slow from Gangplank E Powder Keg and the movement speed granted by Gangplank P Trial by Fire when you destroy a keg.
Kled.phase: Kled falls off after the laning phase and mid game, while Gangplank maintains his strength into the late game with keg range and bombardment.
Kled.teamfight: Keep vision on the flanks to spot Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! coming in, and if a tank is in front, don’t disrupt your backline’s formation. From behind, detonate a Gangplank E Powder Keg pre-placed beside where the enemy will stand with Q Parrrley to slow them, then use Gangplank R Cannon Barrage to block their escape. Don’t engage directly before Kled’s main engage and crowd control are down.

Malphite.watch: Being hit by Malphite Q Seismic Shard makes it difficult to engage or retreat because of the slow, so don’t start a trade immediately afterward. Malphite R Unstoppable Force is an unstoppable dash and can’t be stopped by the slow from Gangplank E Powder Keg. If you can’t see Malphite, watch for an engage from bushes or behind walls and keep your distance from allies.
Malphite.build: Build magic resistance first to withstand the magic damage from Malphite Q Seismic Shard, E Ground Slam, and R Unstoppable Force. Against Malphite’s high armor, include penetration or use the true damage from Gangplank P Trial by Fire. Movement speed is also valuable for escaping telegraphed areas.
Malphite.fight: Break Malphite P Granite Shield first, then trade before the shield comes back. Approach after slowing him with Gangplank E Powder Keg, and don’t stand close to trade basic attacks before Malphite E Ground Slam is down. After Malphite R Unstoppable Force is down is a good window to engage.
Malphite.laning: Manage your mana so you don’t run out by spamming kegs and Q together.
Malphite.combo: Pre-place and prime Gangplank E Powder Keg beside or behind Malphite, and break Malphite P Granite Shield first. Detonate the primed keg with Gangplank Q Parrrley to slow him, then follow up with Q or basic attacks. Gangplank P Trial by Fire’s true damage applies only to melee basic attacks, so don’t count on it applying to Q.
Malphite.escape: Don’t engage immediately after being slowed by Malphite Q Seismic Shard. Once Malphite R Unstoppable Force is down, he has no other mobility ability, so look for an opening then. Use Gangplank W Remove Scurvy immediately after Malphite’s key crowd control hits, and create distance with the slow from Gangplank E Powder Keg and the movement speed from destroying a keg.
Malphite.phase: Gangplank’s keg combos become strong from the mid game onward, and he maintains his strength into the late game with keg range and Gangplank R Cannon Barrage.
Malphite.teamfight: Spread out from your allies so Malphite R Unstoppable Force doesn’t knock several of you up, and don’t stand at the front when Malphite’s position is unknown. Pre-place Gangplank E Powder Keg beside the enemy formation, then detonate it from behind with Q Parrrley to slow them. Overlap Gangplank R Cannon Barrage to block their escape route, and focus your counterattack immediately after Malphite R Unstoppable Force is down.

Nasus.watch: Nasus W Wither reduces your movement and attack speed, so don't enter its range alone. If it hits, immediately use Gangplank W Remove Scurvy to cleanse the crowd control and create distance. When Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active, avoid fighting unless you clearly have both a numbers advantage and a damage advantage, and wait out its duration.
Nasus.build: Build armor first to prepare for Nasus's main damage, Nasus Q Siphoning Strike. Armor won't stop the magic damage from Nasus E Spirit Fire or Nasus R Fury of the Sands, so also make sure you leave the area covered by Nasus E Spirit Fire.
Nasus.fight: Don't recklessly get close early. Place a Gangplank E Powder Keg in advance and let it prime before trading. Keep your distance while Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active.
Nasus.laning: Don't push the lane all the way to Nasus's turret. Let the lane come to you so you don't give him a favorable spot to stack Nasus Q Siphoning Strike. Secure last hits safely with Gangplank Q Parrrley and pressure Nasus when he steps up to stack. Manage your mana so you don't run dry by spamming barrels and Gangplank Q Parrrley. Call for a jungle gank if the lane is pushed toward you.
Nasus.combo: Place a Gangplank E Powder Keg behind or beside the enemy in advance and let it prime. Gangplank P Trial by Fire applies on melee basic attacks, and destroying a barrel resets its cooldown.
Nasus.escape: Look for a chance to get close after Nasus W Wither is down. Nasus has no ability to create distance himself, so slowing him with Gangplank E Powder Keg and following up can force him to use Flash. If Nasus W Wither hits you, cleanse it with Gangplank W Remove Scurvy. Delay your engage while Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active.
Nasus.phase: In the mid game, when barrel combos start to come online, pressure Nasus when he steps up to stack Nasus Q Siphoning Strike. Gangplank also stays powerful in the late game with barrel range and Gangplank R Cannon Barrage, but Nasus becomes harder to deal with as his stacks grow.
Nasus.teamfight: Don't stand in front. Set up a Gangplank E Powder Keg beside the spot Nasus will enter, then detonate it from behind to slow him. Layer Gangplank R Cannon Barrage to block his path. When Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active, keep your distance and fight without meeting him head-on.

Ornn.watch: The pillar from Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture is terrain that Ornn E Searing Charge can hit to knock you up. Move away from it when it appears, and don't let a wall get at your back. Keep your distance if Ornn W Bellows Breath's final flame makes you Brittle. When Ornn R Call of the Forge God starts, dodge the spirit to the side and stay out of the line between Ornn and the spirit.
Ornn.build: Consider prioritizing Tenacity over resistances because getting locked down by Ornn's crowd control in succession is dangerous. Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture and Ornn E Searing Charge deal physical damage, while Ornn W Bellows Breath and Ornn R Call of the Forge God deal magic damage, so don't focus on just one type of resistance. Ornn W Bellows Breath deals damage based on your maximum health, so be careful about stacking only health.
Ornn.fight: Avoid the range where Ornn can catch you, and place a Gangplank E Powder Keg in advance and let it prime. Only follow up with Gangplank Q Parrrley or a basic attack after detonating the barrel to slow him. Even if Ornn E Searing Charge is down, don't go deep while Ornn R Call of the Forge God is still available.
Ornn.laning: Don't spend all your mana on barrels and Q. Stay away from the pillar from Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture and from walls when positioning in lane. Pressure Ornn from a distance where you can interrupt him if he tries to craft an item.
Ornn.combo: Place a Gangplank E Powder Keg behind or beside the enemy in advance and let it prime, then detonate the front barrel with Gangplank Q Parrrley to chain the explosion and apply a slow. Destroying a barrel resets Gangplank P Trial by Fire's cooldown and grants movement speed, which you can also use to get out of Ornn's counterattack range.
Ornn.escape: Engage during a window when both Ornn E Searing Charge and Ornn R Call of the Forge God are down. In particular, look for an opening before Ornn R Call of the Forge God comes back. If Ornn W Bellows Breath makes you Brittle, back off until the effect ends. If you get hit by crowd control, use Gangplank W Remove Scurvy to break the chain; don't use it in advance.
Ornn.phase: Keep your power in the late game with barrel range and artillery, but apply pressure before Ornn's items and his allies' Masterwork upgrades accumulate.
Ornn.teamfight: Don't stand in front. Set up a Gangplank E Powder Keg beside where the enemy will stand, then detonate it from behind with Gangplank Q Parrrley. Layer Gangplank R Cannon Barrage to block the enemy's escape route, but avoid the line between the spirit from Ornn R Call of the Forge God and Ornn. If Ornn still has his main crowd control abilities, help your allies with barrel slows instead of going in yourself.

Olaf.build: Build armor first to prepare for Olaf Q Undertow and his basic attacks. However, Olaf Q Undertow reduces your armor, and resistances can't reduce the true damage from Olaf E Reckless Swing, so make sure you also have health.
Olaf.fight: Keep your distance and move in ways that make it difficult for Olaf to pick up Olaf Q Undertow's axe. Detonate a primed Gangplank E Powder Keg with Gangplank Q Parrrley to slow him, then follow up. If Olaf R Ragnarok is active, don't stand and fight; create distance and wait for its duration to end.
Olaf.laning: While Olaf is strong early, don't push the lane. Secure last hits safely with Gangplank Q Parrrley in front of your turret. Move opposite the direction Olaf Q Undertow's axe lands to make it harder for him to retrieve. Place a Gangplank E Powder Keg where you may fight in advance and let it prime, and budget your mana between farming and trading damage.
Olaf.combo: Place a Gangplank E Powder Keg behind or beside the enemy in advance and let it prime. Detonate the front barrel with Gangplank Q Parrrley to chain the explosion and apply a slow, then follow up from a safe distance. After Olaf R Ragnarok ends, if you can land a melee basic attack, use Gangplank P Trial by Fire's true damage and movement speed increase.
Olaf.escape: Olaf has no ability to create distance himself, so trade when it's difficult for him to retrieve Olaf Q Undertow's axe. While Olaf R Ragnarok is active, create distance instead of relying on Gangplank E Powder Keg's slow to go in. After Olaf R Ragnarok ends, slow him with a barrel you've allowed to prime and decide whether to engage.
Olaf.phase: In the late game, Olaf becomes relatively weaker while Gangplank stays powerful with barrel range and artillery.
Olaf.teamfight: Don't stand in front. Set up a Gangplank E Powder Keg beside the path Olaf will take to approach, then detonate it from behind. Layer Gangplank R Cannon Barrage to block the enemy's movement path, but don't get close relying only on a slow while Olaf R Ragnarok is active. After Olaf R Ragnarok ends, use the barrel's slow; if the opening isn't clear, detonate the barrel and back off.
Olaf.watch: Olaf Q Undertow shreds armor and slows, helping him close the gap. Olaf E Reckless Swing deals true damage, so don’t rely on resistances to stay in when your health is low.

Poppy.fight: Bait out Poppy E Heroic Charge, then close the distance to trade. First detonate a pre-placed, primed Gangplank E Powder Keg with Gangplank Q Parrrley to slow her, then follow up with more attacks.
Poppy.laning: Early on, don't stand with your back to a wall. Secure last hits safely with Gangplank Q Parrrley and hold out without pushing the lane. Place a Gangplank E Powder Keg where you plan to fight in advance and let it prime, and don't spam it alongside Gangplank Q Parrrley until you run out of mana.
Poppy.combo: Set up Gangplank E Powder Keg in advance where Poppy is likely to engage and let it prime. Once Poppy E Heroic Charge is down, detonate the keg with Gangplank Q Parrrley to slow her, then follow up with more attacks. Use Gangplank P Trial by Fire when you can land a melee basic attack.
Poppy.escape: Right after Poppy E Heroic Charge is down, you have a window to close the distance. If Poppy still has crowd control available, don't use Gangplank W Remove Scurvy early; use it as soon as you are hit to stop the follow-up attacks.
Poppy.phase: In the late game, use your keg range and artillery, but stay away from walls where Poppy E Heroic Charge could hit you.
Poppy.teamfight: Don't stand in front. Set up Gangplank E Powder Keg beside where the enemy will stand, then detonate it from behind with Gangplank Q Parrrley to slow them. Layer Gangplank R Cannon Barrage to block their escape route, and only engage directly after Poppy's key crowd control is down.
Poppy.build: Build armor first against Poppy’s main damage: Poppy Q Hammer Shock, Poppy E Heroic Charge, and Poppy R Keeper's Verdict. Poppy Q Hammer Shock deals damage based on your max health, so avoid choices that add a lot of health alone. Don’t spend extra resources on magic resistance for Poppy alone.
Poppy.watch: Poppy E Heroic Charge stuns you if it knocks you into a wall, so don’t stand with your back to one; stay in open space. If Poppy Q Hammer Shock hits you, walk out of the area before the second blast. When you see Poppy R Keeper's Verdict charging, move to the side from in front of her.

Pantheon.watch: Pantheon W Shield Vault targets and stuns you, so stay out of its range. If it hits, cleanse the stun right away with Gangplank W Remove Scurvy to interrupt his combo. Keep minions between you and Pantheon Q Comet Spear, and don't attack Pantheon from the front while Pantheon E Aegis Assault is active.
Pantheon.build: Build armor first because Pantheon's main damage is physical. However, Pantheon R Grand Starfall has penetration, and Pantheon W Shield Vault deals damage based on your maximum health, so don't rely on stacking only armor or health. Mix in penetration against Pantheon's high armor, and make use of Gangplank P Trial by Fire's true damage.
Pantheon.fight: Don't give Pantheon W Shield Vault its range. Slow him with Gangplank E Powder Keg before following up with more attacks. If Pantheon E Aegis Assault is active, wait for it to end or reposition to attack from the side.
Pantheon.laning: Early on, don't push the wave; farm safely in front of your turret with Gangplank Q Parrrley. Keep minions between you and Pantheon Q Comet Spear, and stay out of Pantheon W Shield Vault range. Don't spam Gangplank E Powder Keg and Gangplank Q Parrrley until you run out of mana.
Pantheon.combo: Set up Gangplank E Powder Keg beside or behind Pantheon in advance and let it prime. If Pantheon E Aegis Assault is blocking attacks from the front, wait for it to end or detonate the keg from the side.
Pantheon.escape: Once Pantheon W Shield Vault is down, you have a chance to engage, but Pantheon can escape with Pantheon R Grand Starfall if it's still available. Look to engage when both movement abilities are down, especially before Pantheon R Grand Starfall comes back up. If you're already stunned, cleanse it with Gangplank W Remove Scurvy, then create distance.
Pantheon.phase: By mid game, Gangplank E Powder Keg combos can start hitting all at once, and Gangplank R Cannon Barrage can affect other lanes. Pantheon's influence falls off in the late game, while Gangplank stays strong with Gangplank E Powder Keg range and artillery.
Pantheon.teamfight: Don't stand in front. Set up Gangplank E Powder Keg beside where the enemy will stand, outside Pantheon W Shield Vault range. From behind, detonate the keg with Gangplank Q Parrrley to slow him, and layer Gangplank R Cannon Barrage to block his escape route. Only engage directly after Pantheon's key abilities are down, and save Gangplank W Remove Scurvy to cleanse a stun.

Renekton.watch: When Renekton's Fury from Renekton P Reign of Anger is near or above half, watch out for an empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator. Renekton E Slice and Dice can dash a long distance by using minions as a stepping stone, so don't stand in or behind a minion wave. Use Gangplank W Remove Scurvy as soon as you're stunned to interrupt his combo.
Renekton.build: The guide doesn't specify a concrete first item to buy. Prioritize armor against the damage from Renekton Q Cull the Meek, Renekton W Ruthless Predator, and Renekton E Slice and Dice. Armor can't block the damage from Renekton R Dominus, and positioning to avoid empowered Renekton E Slice and Dice is important.
Renekton.fight: When Renekton has no Fury, start the trade by slowing him with Gangplank E Powder Keg. You have a chance to retaliate right after Renekton uses Renekton Q Cull the Meek, Renekton W Ruthless Predator, and Renekton E Slice and Dice.
Renekton.laning: Harass Renekton when he approaches minions to build Fury, but avoid positions where minions give Renekton E Slice and Dice a way to engage. Don't spam E Powder Keg and Q; save your resources for trades.
Renekton.combo: Set up Gangplank E Powder Keg where you plan to fight, then wait until it can be detonated in one hit. If Renekton W Ruthless Predator stuns you, cleanse it with Gangplank W Remove Scurvy to interrupt his follow-up combo.
Renekton.escape: Right after Renekton uses Renekton E Slice and Dice to retreat, you have a chance to close the distance. If Renekton W Ruthless Predator is also down and he has no Fury, engage after first slowing him with Gangplank E Powder Keg. If Renekton dashes in and lands his combo, retreat in a direction with no target for him to dash through again.
Renekton.phase: From mid game onward, Gangplank's keg combos become strong and Renekton's value falls, so trade using kegs you've set up. In the late game, make use of Gangplank E Powder Keg range and Gangplank R Cannon Barrage.
Renekton.teamfight: Don't stand in front. Set up Gangplank E Powder Keg beside where Renekton will stand, then detonate it from behind with Gangplank Q Parrrley. Layer Gangplank R Cannon Barrage to block the enemy's retreat route and maintain the slow. Engage directly only after key abilities like Renekton W Ruthless Predator are down.

Rumble.watch: Rumble Q Flamespitter deals damage based on maximum health while you're nearby, so create distance when Rumble approaches. If Rumble E Electro Harpoon's first shot hits you, retreat immediately to avoid the second shot's heavy slow and magic resistance reduction.
Rumble.build: If you need a defensive item, choose one with magic resistance first. Rumble P Junkyard Titan and Rumble Q Flamespitter deal damage based on your maximum health, so avoid investing heavily in health alone.
Rumble.fight: Follow up with more attacks after Rumble W Scrap Shield's shield disappears, and use Gangplank P Trial by Fire when you can land a melee basic attack.
Rumble.laning: Pre-place and prime Gangplank E Powder Keg where you plan to fight, and manage your mana between farming and trading.
Rumble.combo: Set up Gangplank E Powder Keg beside or behind the enemy in advance and let it prime. Once Rumble W Scrap Shield's shield disappears, detonate the keg with Gangplank Q Parrrley to slow him, then follow up with Q or a basic attack.
Rumble.escape: If Rumble E Electro Harpoon's first shot hits you, create distance before the second shot arrives. Your chance to engage comes after Rumble uses E and runs out of Rumble W Scrap Shield's shield and movement speed. At that point, catch him with the slow from Gangplank E Powder Keg.
Rumble.phase: In the late game, continue using your keg range and artillery.
Rumble.teamfight: Don't stand in front. Set up Gangplank E Powder Keg beside where Rumble will stand, then detonate it from behind with Gangplank Q Parrrley. Layer Gangplank R Cannon Barrage to block the enemy's retreat route and maintain the slow. Look to engage directly only after key abilities like Rumble E Electro Harpoon are down.

Quinn.watch: When Quinn P Harrier marks you, move out of basic attack range to avoid her empowered attack. Stand behind the minion line so Quinn Q Blinding Assault hits a minion first, and don’t approach her alone while Quinn E Vault is available.
Quinn.build: Quinn’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. There’s no reason to build magic resistance against her damage.
Quinn.fight: Trade right after Quinn E Vault is used or when your jungler arrives.
Quinn.escape: The window to engage is right after Quinn E Vault is used. If Quinn E Vault hits and slows you, immediately use Gangplank W Remove Scurvy to cleanse the crowd control. Close the distance only while Quinn’s escape is unavailable.
Quinn.phase: In the late game, use your keg range and artillery. Respond to roams with Quinn R Behind Enemy Lines using vision and early pings.
Quinn.teamfight: Overlap Gangplank R Cannon Barrage to block Quinn’s and the enemy team’s escape routes.
Quinn.combo: Pre-place Gangplank E Powder Keg where you plan to fight and let its health tick down. When destroying a keg resets Gangplank P Trial by Fire’s cooldown, use it in your follow-up movement.
Quinn.laning: You’re outranged early, so preserve your health and safely last-hit with Gangplank Q Parrrley. Farm while Quinn P Harrier’s mark is absent, and hold on under your turret when losing. Decide ahead of time how many kegs to spend on trades so you don’t burn through your mana with Q.

Riven.watch: Riven can close the distance with Riven Q Broken Wings and Riven E Valor, then follow up with the stun from Riven W Ki Burst and empowered basic attacks. Move back when you see her first dash, and break her combo by using Gangplank W Remove Scurvy immediately after being stunned. When Riven R Blade of the Exile is active, her range increases, and Wind Slash becomes more dangerous the lower health is, so keep your distance until it expires.
Riven.build: Riven’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. If she gets ahead, prioritize defensive items sooner and get health to reduce the threat of a finishing blow from Riven R Blade of the Exile.
Riven.fight: Trade when Riven uses Riven Q Broken Wings to clear minions. Don’t go deep while both Riven Q Broken Wings and Riven E Valor are available; use the slow from a pre-placed, primed Gangplank E Powder Keg to control the distance.
Riven.escape: Don’t engage just because Riven Q Broken Wings alone is down. Look for a window before Riven Q Broken Wings comes back up, but check that Riven E Valor and Riven W Ki Burst are also unavailable before going in. If she catches you, use Gangplank W Remove Scurvy right after the stun, then create distance with the slow from Gangplank E Powder Keg and the movement speed from Gangplank P Trial by Fire.
Riven.phase: Gangplank is weak early because he lacks time to let Gangplank E Powder Keg prime, so play safely. Use keg range and artillery in the late game too, but keep your distance while Riven’s dashes are available.
Riven.teamfight: Don’t stand in front. Set up Gangplank E Powder Keg beside Riven’s approach path and detonate it from behind with Gangplank Q Parrrley. Overlap Gangplank R Cannon Barrage to maintain the slow and block the enemy’s retreat. Save your direct engage until Riven’s mobility and crowd control are unavailable.
Riven.combo: Pre-place Gangplank E Powder Keg to Riven’s side or behind her and let its health tick down. When chaining kegs, focus on extending their range and keeping the slow up rather than trying to overlap their damage.
Riven.laning: Keep your distance early, safely last-hit with Gangplank Q Parrrley, and hold on without pushing the wave. Pre-place Gangplank E Powder Keg where you plan to fight and let its health tick down, and don’t waste mana spamming kegs and Gangplank Q Parrrley. Poke Riven in the opening after she uses Riven Q Broken Wings to clear minions.

Sett.watch: Sett E Facebreaker stuns if there are targets on both sides of him, so don’t stand on the opposite side of a minion wave. Sett W Haymaker is dangerous right after he has taken a lot of damage, so deal damage and create distance; when dodging, move sideways away from the center of its aim. Sett R The Show Stopper suppresses you if it catches you, so stay out of Sett’s grab range while his R is available.
Sett.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Sett P Pit Grit and Sett Q Knuckle Down. Sett Q Knuckle Down scales with your maximum health, so avoid choices that add a lot of health alone. You can’t reduce the true damage at the center of Sett W Haymaker with resistances, so position yourself to avoid the center.
Sett.fight: Keep your distance first while Sett has tools available to catch you. Start trades with the slow from Gangplank E Powder Keg, then back off after dealing damage so Sett W Haymaker’s Grit can wear off. If Sett E Facebreaker catches you, use Gangplank W Remove Scurvy to remove the crowd control and create distance again.
Sett.laning: Set up Gangplank E Powder Keg where you plan to fight and let it age until you can detonate it in one hit. If you spam kegs and Q together until you’re out of mana, you’ll have trouble responding when Sett engages, so decide how many kegs to use for the trade.
Sett.combo: Follow up with Q or a basic attack, but remember that the burn from Gangplank P Trial by Fire only applies to melee basic attacks. Chaining keg detonations resets the passive’s cooldown and increases your movement speed, letting you control your distance from Sett.
Sett.escape: Look for an opportunity to engage while Sett R The Show Stopper is down, since Sett has no dash available then. If Sett E Facebreaker is also down, slow him first with Gangplank E Powder Keg and trade. If you’ve already used Gangplank W Remove Scurvy, be careful about engaging since you can’t respond to the next crowd control.
Sett.phase: In the late game, use your keg range and artillery, but stay alert to Sett’s engage range.
Sett.teamfight: Overlap Gangplank R Cannon Barrage to block the enemy’s retreat. Only engage directly after Sett’s key abilities are down; if the opening isn’t clear, detonate a keg and back off.

Shen.watch: If Shen E Shadow Dash taunts you, you will take basic attacks empowered by Shen Q Twilight Assault, so dodge the dash. If it hits you, use Gangplank W Remove Scurvy to cleanse the taunt. Also move out of the Spirit Blade’s path as it returns to Shen to reduce the damage from Shen Q Twilight Assault.
Shen.build: The time you’re held by the taunt from Shen E Shadow Dash is dangerous, so prioritize tenacity. Shen E Shadow Dash deals physical damage and Shen Q Twilight Assault deals magic damage, so don’t focus on only one resistance or stack health alone.
Shen.fight: Trade right after Shen E Shadow Dash misses. Slow him first with Gangplank E Powder Keg, then follow up with damage. If Shen W Spirit's Refuge is active, attack with abilities instead of basic attacks.
Shen.laning: Afterward, take lane priority to keep Shen occupied with CS, and take advantage of the empty lane when he leaves with Shen R Stand United.
Shen.combo: Set up Gangplank E Powder Keg beside or behind the enemy and let it age, then detonate it with Gangplank Q Parrrley to slow them. Follow up with Gangplank Q Parrrley or a basic attack, but remember that Gangplank P Trial by Fire only applies to melee basic attacks, so hold your basic attacks while Shen W Spirit's Refuge is active.
Shen.escape: When Shen E Shadow Dash misses, his taunt and only regular mobility tool are down, so engage then. If Shen R Stand United is still available, he can escape, so look for a decisive engage before Shen R Stand United comes back.
Shen.phase: In the late game, use your keg range and artillery.
Shen.teamfight: Don’t stand in front. Set up Gangplank E Powder Keg beside the enemy formation and detonate it from behind with Gangplank Q Parrrley. Overlap Gangplank R Cannon Barrage to block their escape route, and look to engage directly after Shen E Shadow Dash is used.

Sion.watch: If you let Sion Q Decimating Smash charge for too long, it can knock you up and stun you, so move to the side as soon as the charge begins. Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught travels almost in a straight line, so avoid narrow paths and sidestep. Sion E Roar of the Slayer reduces your armor and slows you, so be extra careful about your distance right after it hits.
Sion.build: Build armor first against the main damage from Sion P Glory in Death, Q Decimating Smash, and R Unstoppable Onslaught. Sion W Soul Furnace and E Roar of the Slayer deal magic damage, so armor cannot block them, and Sion E Roar of the Slayer also reduces the armor you have built.
Sion.fight: Since Sion has several ways to catch you, keep your distance first, then use a prepared Gangplank E Powder Keg to slow him before trading. When Sion W Soul Furnace is active, look for a chance to break the shield with E Powder Keg and Gangplank Q Parrrley before it explodes. If Sion Q Decimating Smash's crowd control hits you, use Gangplank W Remove Scurvy to cleanse it and interrupt his combo.
Sion.laning: Do not force an approach early; safely last-hit with Gangplank Q Parrrley. If you keep giving Sion CS, his maximum health increases permanently, so when you can use a keg combo, disrupt his farming or gain an advantage in another lane. Spamming Gangplank E Powder Keg and Q Parrrley together will drain your mana, so reserve kegs for trades and leave enough mana to farm.
Sion.combo: Set up Gangplank E Powder Keg beside or behind Sion in advance and let it age enough to detonate in one hit. Detonate the keg in front with Gangplank Q Parrrley to extend the chain explosion's range and slow him, then follow up with Q or a basic attack. The burn from Gangplank P Trial by Fire applies only on melee basic attacks, and destroying a keg resets the passive’s cooldown.
Sion.escape: Enter only after dodging Sion Q Decimating Smash's crowd control or confirming it has been used. If you have already used Gangplank W Remove Scurvy, you cannot cleanse the crowd control that follows, so do not re-engage.
Sion.phase: Your keg range and artillery remain strong late, but Sion keeps increasing his maximum health through CS, so do not let him farm freely.
Sion.teamfight: Do not stand in front. Set Gangplank E Powder Keg in advance along Sion's approach and beside the enemy team. Detonate it from behind with Gangplank Q Parrrley to slow them, then overlap Gangplank R Cannon Barrage to block their movement paths. After taking Sion down, reposition to avoid his Sion P Glory in Death revival attacks.

Skarner.fight: Close the distance and trade right after you bait out Skarner E Ixtal's Impact. First detonate Gangplank E Powder Keg to slow him, then follow up with Gangplank Q Parrrley or a basic attack. Approaching to land a basic attack before slowing him exposes you to Skarner's catch tools.
Skarner.laning: Early on, do not push the lane; safely last-hit with Gangplank Q Parrrley. Set Gangplank E Powder Keg where you plan to fight and wait until it can detonate in one hit. If you spam kegs and Gangplank Q Parrrley until your mana runs out, it will be hard to fight back when Skarner engages.
Skarner.combo: Set up Gangplank E Powder Keg behind or beside Skarner in advance and let it age. Detonate the keg in front with Gangplank Q Parrrley to create a chain explosion and slow him, then follow up with Gangplank Q Parrrley or a basic attack.
Skarner.escape: Right after Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is used is your chance to close the distance or pick Skarner off. If you get slammed into a wall, the cooldown of Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is greatly reduced, so anticipate the next dash and back away.
Skarner.phase: Your keg range and artillery remain strong late, but if you give Skarner time to complete his items, he can endure for a long time and keep catching you, so maintain your distance.
Skarner.teamfight: Do not stand in front. Set Gangplank E Powder Keg beside where Skarner will enter, then detonate it from behind with Gangplank Q Parrrley to slow him. Overlap Gangplank R Cannon Barrage to block the enemy's escape route and the area around the keg. Avoid walls and the edges of objective pits so Skarner E Ixtal's Impact and Skarner R Impale cannot catch you, and look to engage directly only after his key crowd control is used.
Skarner.build: First decide whether you need a way to break Skarner R Impale; if so, include Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar in your build. When building resistances, prioritize magic resistance for the damage from Skarner P Threads of Vibration, Skarner W Seismic Bastion, and Skarner R Impale. Skarner P Threads of Vibration and Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval scale with your max health, so be cautious about choices that only add health.

Singed.build: Prioritize magic resistance over armor or health against Singed's damage. Movement speed also matters so you can walk out of Singed Q Poison Trail.
Singed.fight: Early on, secure enough time for Gangplank E Powder Keg to age before trading. If Singed W Mega Adhesive and E Fling are on cooldown, you can close in while he has no ability to create distance himself.
Singed.laning: Safely last-hit with Gangplank Q Parrrley while looking for chances to poke, and lower Singed's health early to force him to recall. Decide in advance which kegs to use for trades so you do not spam kegs and Q until your mana runs out.
Singed.combo: Set Gangplank E Powder Keg behind or beside where Singed will pass and let it age. Gangplank P Trial by Fire applies on a melee basic attack, but not on Q.
Singed.escape: Engage after Singed W Mega Adhesive and E Fling are used. If E Fling hits you, use Gangplank W Remove Scurvy to remove the impairing effect and interrupt the follow-up; go around areas covered by adhesive.
Singed.phase: Late game, use your keg range and artillery, but do not chase a stronger Singed through his poison trail.
Singed.teamfight: Do not stand in front or chase Singed to the end. Set Gangplank E Powder Keg in advance along his approach and detonate it from behind to slow him. Overlap Gangplank R Cannon Barrage to block the space Singed and his allies can occupy and their retreat route. Attack Singed's allies while he is pinned, and engage directly only after Singed's key disruption abilities are used.
Singed.watch: Don’t chase a low-health Singed while walking through Singed Q Poison Trail. Avoid areas covered by Singed W Mega Adhesive, and keep your distance so Singed E Fling there doesn’t lead into a root. If Singed is standing with his back to his allies, he can use E Fling to send you into them, so don’t stand in front of him.

Trundle.watch: Trundle Q Chomp reduces Gangplank’s attack damage, so avoid trading while the effect lasts. Trundle W Frozen Domain increases his attack speed and healing, so back out of it. Trundle E Pillar of Ice can block your escape through narrow paths, so fight in open areas and sidestep as soon as the pillar appears.
Trundle.build: Build armor first against Trundle Q Chomp and his basic attacks. Reducing attack speed can also be effective against the attack speed bonus from Trundle W Frozen Domain. Trundle R Subjugate reduces your resistances and deals damage based on your maximum health, so prioritize creating distance over stacking only resistances or health.
Trundle.fight: Trade after the attack damage reduction from Trundle Q Chomp wears off and you’re outside Trundle W Frozen Domain. Use Gangplank E Powder Keg to slow him first and control the distance, then land a basic attack empowered by Gangplank P Trial by Fire only when you can safely get close. Keep your distance while Trundle R Subjugate is active.
Trundle.laning: Early on, don’t push the lane; safely last-hit with Gangplank Q Parrrley. Trundle P King’s Tribute heals him whenever a unit dies, so avoid drawn-out fights where you only chip away at his health with poke. If you’ve reduced his health, capitalize immediately or push the lane to force him to recall.
Trundle.escape: Engage in open terrain after Trundle E Pillar of Ice is on cooldown. Trundle has no skill to create distance himself, so start a fight when Gangplank E Powder Keg’s slow gives you an opening to close in.
Trundle.phase: In mid game, use Gangplank E Powder Keg chains to extend your engage range and Gangplank R Cannon Barrage to influence other lanes. Gangplank E Powder Keg and your cannon barrage remain effective late, but avoid fighting alone on a side lane against Trundle while he has Trundle R Subjugate.
Trundle.teamfight: Don’t stand in front. Place Gangplank E Powder Keg beside where the enemy will stand, then detonate it from behind with Gangplank Q Parrrley. Layer Gangplank R Cannon Barrage to block their escape while slowing them. Keep your distance from Trundle and target someone else while Trundle R Subjugate is active.
Trundle.combo: Pre-place Gangplank E Powder Keg where you plan to fight, and let its health drop until one hit can detonate it. Detonate a keg behind or beside Trundle with Gangplank Q Parrrley to slow him, then follow up with another Q or basic attacks. Use the Gangplank P Trial by Fire reset from destroying the keg with a basic attack when you can safely get in range.

Teemo.watch: Teemo Q Blinding Dart negates basic attacks, so don’t fight with basic attacks while you’re blinded; use abilities or back away. Even a single basic attack carrying Teemo E Toxic Shot causes ongoing poison damage, so stay out of range unless you’re ready to go in. Also watch for Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare in bushes you have no vision of and Teemo R Noxious Trap along key paths.
Teemo.build: Teemo Q Blinding Dart, Teemo E Toxic Shot, and Teemo R Noxious Trap deal primarily magic damage, so build magic resistance first. Prepare Oracle Lens to deal with traps near objectives and in narrow paths.
Teemo.fight: Early on, avoid brief trades where you take hits within Teemo’s basic attack range and then back away. After Teemo Q Blinding Dart is used, detonate a Gangplank E Powder Keg you prepared earlier to slow him and close the distance. Once you’re close, follow up with a melee basic attack empowered by Gangplank P Trial by Fire.
Teemo.laning: Place Gangplank E Powder Keg ahead of time where you plan to fight and let it prime, while saving mana for the keg and Q. Don’t walk straight past a bush you have no vision of; use a Control Ward or take another route.
Teemo.combo: Place Gangplank E Powder Keg ahead of time behind or beside the opponent and wait until it can be detonated in one hit. Follow up with a melee basic attack empowered by Gangplank P Trial by Fire while you’re not blinded.
Teemo.escape: Just after Teemo Q Blinding Dart is used is your chance to engage and follow up with basic attacks. If Teemo has already used Teemo W Move Quick, use Gangplank E Powder Keg’s slow to find an opening to close the distance. If slowed by Teemo R Noxious Trap, cleanse it with Gangplank W Remove Scurvy and disengage.
Teemo.phase: Keg range and your cannon barrage remain effective late, but watch out for Teemo R Noxious Trap that has been placed for a while as you move.
Teemo.teamfight: Don’t stand in front. Place Gangplank E Powder Keg beside where the opponent will stand, then detonate it from behind with Gangplank Q Parrrley. Layer Gangplank R Cannon Barrage to block their escape and keep them slowed. Near objectives and in narrow corridors, move while using Oracle Lens to clear Teemo R Noxious Trap.

Tryndamere.watch: Back away when Tryndamere builds Fury by hitting minions before Tryndamere P Battle Fury makes his critical strikes stronger. Tryndamere E Spinning Slash can close the distance, so don’t chase him where there are lots of minions. When Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, use Gangplank E Powder Keg’s slow to create distance and let its duration run out.
Tryndamere.build: Tryndamere deals primarily physical damage, so build armor first. Thornmail is also worth considering since he relies on basic attacks.
Tryndamere.fight: Set up Gangplank E Powder Keg in advance and let it age, then detonate it to slow Tryndamere just after Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is used. Don’t pour damage into him while Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active; create distance and attack after it ends.
Tryndamere.laning: Early on, safely last-hit with Gangplank Q Parrrley and hold on without pushing the lane. If Tryndamere hits minions to build Fury, he may engage soon, so back away in advance. Don’t spam Gangplank E Powder Keg and Q together; save mana to counterattack.
Tryndamere.combo: Place Gangplank E Powder Keg ahead of time behind or beside the opponent and let it prime. Gangplank P Trial by Fire empowers melee basic attacks, and destroying a keg resets its cooldown.
Tryndamere.escape: Just after you bait out Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is your chance to close in and attack. When backing away, walk backward while facing Tryndamere to avoid the slow from Tryndamere W Mocking Shout. If slowed, cleanse it with Gangplank W Remove Scurvy and create distance.
Tryndamere.phase: Use keg range and your cannon barrage late, but don’t go alone to defend a side lane against Tryndamere when Tryndamere R Undying Rage is ready.
Tryndamere.teamfight: Layer Gangplank R Cannon Barrage to block the opponent’s escape. When Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, use your slow to create distance and let its duration run out.

Urgot.watch: If Urgot E Disdain hits you, you can easily be stunned and hit with a follow-up, so avoid his engage angle. If it does hit, immediately use Gangplank W Remove Scurvy to remove the crowd control. Urgot Q Corrosive Charge slows heavily and marks a target for his fire, so dodge it when it comes your way. If Urgot R Fear Beyond Death hits you, get completely out of range before you reach the execute threshold.
Urgot.build: Urgot deals primarily physical damage, so build armor first. Urgot P Echoing Flames scales with your maximum health, so be wary of choices that add a lot of health alone. Add penetration to Gangplank’s physical damage to deal with Urgot’s high armor, and keep an eye on your total health to stay above the execute threshold.
Urgot.fight: Stay outside Urgot’s short range and trade with Gangplank Q Parrrley and Gangplank E Powder Keg.
