Look for an opening to close in only just after Urgot E Disdain is used, and avoid staying close long enough to take multiple hits from Urgot P Echoing Flames. If Urgot approaches with Urgot W Purge active, create distance by walking rather than relying only on a slow.
Urgot.laning: Place Gangplank E Powder Keg ahead of time where you plan to fight and wait until it can be detonated in one hit. Don’t spam the keg and Q together; preserve mana and distance to prepare for Urgot E Disdain.
Urgot.combo: Pre-place and prime Gangplank E Powder Keg beside or behind Urgot, then detonate the keg in front with Gangplank Q Parrrley to slow him. If you linked kegs together, extend your reach with the explosion, then follow up with Q or a basic attack. Gangplank P Trial by Fire applies only to melee basic attacks, so don’t close in just to apply it while Urgot E Disdain is still available.
Urgot.escape: Urgot E Disdain is his movement and engage tool, so just after you bait it out is a brief window to close the distance. Even then, trade briefly while staying out of range of Urgot Q Corrosive Charge and Urgot R Fear Beyond Death. If you’ve already used Gangplank W Remove Scurvy, you can’t cleanse the next crowd control effect, so delay your engage.
Urgot.phase: Late game, use Gangplank E Powder Keg’s range and your cannon barrage to fight from outside Urgot’s short range.
Urgot.teamfight: Don’t stand in front. Place Gangplank E Powder Keg beside where Urgot will stand, then detonate it from behind with Gangplank Q Parrrley. Layer Gangplank R Cannon Barrage to block Urgot’s engage position and escape route. Don’t go in directly before Urgot E Disdain is used, and keep in mind that you can cleanse only one crowd control effect with Gangplank W Remove Scurvy.

Udyr.watch: Watch for Udyr E Blazing Stampede, which lets him close in quickly and stun you. Udyr Q Wilding Claw is dangerous because of its empowered basic attacks and max-health damage, while Udyr R Wingborne Storm slows in an area and deals max-health damage. Keep your distance before he can catch you.
Udyr.build: Build armor first to prepare for Udyr’s basic-attack-focused damage. Udyr Q Wilding Claw mixes two damage types, and armor does not block Udyr R Wingborne Storm’s damage, so armor alone cannot cover all of it. A large health increase also makes both abilities’ max-health damage higher.
Udyr.fight: After Udyr E Blazing Stampede is down, detonate a pre-placed and primed Gangplank E Powder Keg to slow him and manage your distance. Once Udyr W Iron Mantle’s shield is gone, follow up so he has no chance to heal. Applying Gangplank P Trial by Fire to Udyr requires a melee basic attack, so don’t approach before detonating the keg.
Udyr.laning: When Udyr is out of sight, don’t push forward; ward key paths and jungle entrances. Early on, safely last-hit with Gangplank Q Parrrley and hold the lane without pushing. Don’t spam kegs and Q together; save mana to respond to Udyr’s approach.
Udyr.combo: Pre-place and prime Gangplank E Powder Keg behind or beside where Udyr is likely to arrive. When chaining kegs, use them to extend your range and maintain the slow rather than to stack damage.
Udyr.escape: The moment after you bait out Udyr E Blazing Stampede is your window to close in and attack. After Udyr E Blazing Stampede stuns you once, he cannot stun the same target again for a while, so use Gangplank W Remove Scurvy to cleanse the stun and counterattack or escape.
Udyr.phase: In the late game, use your keg range and bombardment while continuing to watch for Udyr E Blazing Stampede’s approach.
Udyr.teamfight: Overlap Gangplank R Cannon Barrage to block the enemy’s escape route. Don’t force a fight against a tanky Udyr with Udyr W Iron Mantle active; clear the weaker enemies behind him first, then fight with a numbers advantage.

Volibear.watch: Volibear Q Thundering Smash closes in quickly and stuns, so stay out of range of its empowered basic attack and wait it out. If it hits you, use Gangplank W Remove Scurvy to cleanse the stun. When you see the mark from Volibear E Sky Splitter, sidestep to avoid its damage and slow. While Volibear R Stormbringer is available, watch for dives even under your turret, and move away from the landing point when his leap is telegraphed.
Volibear.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Volibear Q Thundering Smash, W Frenzied Maul, and R Stormbringer. Grievous Wounds helps against healing from Volibear W Frenzied Maul, and reducing his attack speed is also effective for taking fewer basic attacks.
Volibear.fight: Don’t take a fight while stacks of Volibear P The Relentless Storm are built up; look for an opening after they expire. Don’t let Volibear W Frenzied Maul heal him over a long fight; back off if you can’t finish him decisively.
Volibear.laning: When behind, last-hit in front of your turret with Gangplank Q Parrrley and pre-place Gangplank E Powder Keg where you’ll fight. Don’t spam Gangplank Q Parrrley and E Powder Keg together; save mana to counterattack and escape.
Volibear.combo: Pre-place and prime Gangplank E Powder Keg where Volibear is likely to approach. Detonate the keg with Gangplank Q Parrrley to slow him, then follow up with Q Parrrley or a basic attack.
Volibear.escape: The opening to engage comes after Volibear Q Thundering Smash is down and the stacks of P The Relentless Storm have expired. Look for a moment when Volibear R Stormbringer is also unavailable, and don’t go in if you’ve already used Gangplank W Remove Scurvy and can’t respond to a stun.
Volibear.phase: Gangplank is weak early, so farm safely and minimize losses. In the late game, use E Powder Keg range and bombardment while watching for Volibear’s engage.
Volibear.teamfight: Overlap Gangplank R Cannon Barrage to block Volibear’s and the enemy team’s paths.

Yone.watch: When Yone Q Mortal Steel builds up into a whirlwind through minions, watch for the knock-up and dash, and keep your distance until the stack disappears. When Yone E Soul Unbound dives in, secure room to retreat while accounting for the Yone Q Mortal Steel and Yone R Fate Sealed that may follow. Yone R Fate Sealed can pull you in and lead into follow-up attacks, so avoid its path and the back of your formation.
Yone.build: Prioritize movement speed so you can get out of Yone’s telegraphed attack range. Yone Q Mortal Steel deals physical damage, while Yone P Way of the Hunter deals magic damage, so don’t focus on only one resistance if you build defenses. Yone W Spirit Cleave deals damage based on your max health, so be wary of relying on a large health increase alone.
Yone.fight: When Yone Q Mortal Steel’s whirlwind is ready, don’t approach first. After the stack disappears, start a trade with a pre-placed and primed Gangplank E Powder Keg. Use the keg’s slow to manage your distance rather than blindly trading into Yone W Spirit Cleave’s shield. Don’t go deep just because Yone E Soul Unbound is down; also check Yone Q Mortal Steel and Yone R Fate Sealed.
Yone.laning: When Yone repeatedly uses Yone Q Mortal Steel on minions to prepare a whirlwind, back off and safely last-hit with Gangplank Q Parrrley. Keep kegs available for trades and save mana for farming so you do not spam kegs and Q at the same time.
Yone.escape: The chance to trade comes after Yone Q Mortal Steel’s whirlwind disappears and Yone E Soul Unbound is down. Before going deep, check whether Yone R Fate Sealed is also down. If Yone catches you, use Gangplank W Remove Scurvy immediately after the key crowd control hits to interrupt his follow-up combo.
Yone.phase: From mid game, your Gangplank E Powder Keg combos come online, and Gangplank R Cannon Barrage can affect other lanes. In the late game, use keg range and bombardment, but stay out of the dash range of a Yone who has grown stronger through items.
Yone.teamfight: Yone W Spirit Cleave grants a larger shield when it hits multiple people, so don’t stand grouped with your allies. Check your position so Yone R Fate Sealed doesn’t catch your back line. Overlap Gangplank R Cannon Barrage with your kegs to restrict Yone’s and the enemy team’s paths.
Yone.combo: Pre-place Gangplank E Powder Keg where Yone will enter and let its health drop until one hit can detonate it. Use the Gangplank P Trial by Fire reset from destroying the keg with a melee basic attack; Q itself does not apply the burn.

Yorick.watch: Yorick E Mourning Mist slows, marks, and deals max-health damage, so watch its trajectory and dodge it. If trapped by Yorick W Dark Procession, hit the wall to break it. If the Maiden of the Mist summoned by Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles starts attacking you, create distance from Yorick himself.
Yorick.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Yorick Q Last Rites and the Mist Walkers. Yorick E Mourning Mist and Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles deal magic damage based on max health, so avoid relying on a large health increase alone.
Yorick.fight: After dodging Yorick E Mourning Mist, start a fight where there are few graves and Mist Walkers. Slow him first and approach with a pre-primed Gangplank E Powder Keg, then apply Gangplank P Trial by Fire, refreshed by detonating the keg, with a melee basic attack.
Yorick.laning: When you have room, push the lane so minions die under the enemy turret and graves don’t build up near Yorick. Save mana for kegs and Q.
Yorick.combo: Pre-place Gangplank E Powder Keg behind or beside the enemy and wait for health to drop.
Yorick.escape: Engage after Yorick E Mourning Mist misses and Yorick W Dark Procession is down. Yorick has no mobility, so this is a good time to close the distance; but if there are many Mist Walkers or the Maiden of the Mist is with him, clear them first or keep your distance.
Yorick.phase: In the late game, use kegs and bombardment while answering Yorick’s side-lane pressure.
Yorick.teamfight: Overlap Gangplank R Cannon Barrage to block the escape route. When approaching directly, look for an opening after key crowd-control tools such as Yorick W Dark Procession are down.

Yasuo.watch: Yasuo E Sweeping Blade lets him close the distance by dashing through minions, so keep your distance when there are many minions. After Yasuo Q Steel Tempest hits twice, his next Q launches a tornado, so watch the effect and dodge sideways out of its path. If it knocks you up, Yasuo R Last Breath can follow.
Yasuo.build: Buy armor items first to prepare for the physical damage from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest and R Last Breath. Attack speed reduction also slows how often the tornado from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest comes back. Armor does not block the magic damage from Yasuo E Sweeping Blade.
Yasuo.fight: Trigger Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield first with light poke, then commit to a trade. Right after Yasuo Q Steel Tempest’s tornado misses, use Gangplank E Powder Keg to slow him and look for follow-up damage. If Yasuo W Wind Wall is active, save Gangplank Q Parrrley and use it after the wall disappears.
Yasuo.laning: Early on, don’t push the lane; safely last-hit with Gangplank Q Parrrley in front of your turret. Keep a thin minion wave pushed toward your side to reduce the minions Yasuo E Sweeping Blade can dash through. Don’t spam Gangplank E Powder Keg or Q; save mana for fights.
Yasuo.combo: Place Gangplank E Powder Keg where you plan to fight and let it mature enough to detonate in one hit. Remove Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield first, then detonate a keg behind or beside him with Gangplank Q Parrrley to slow him. Follow up with Q or an auto attack, but Gangplank P Trial by Fire’s burn only applies on melee attacks.
Yasuo.escape: The moment after Yasuo Q Steel Tempest throws its tornado is an opening to engage. However, Yasuo E Sweeping Blade can still be used to reposition, so don’t dive deep just because one mobility spell is down. Look to engage with the slow from Gangplank E Powder Keg before Yasuo R Last Breath comes back up.
Yasuo.phase: Even in the late game, use your keg range and artillery to stay strong.
Yasuo.teamfight: Don’t stand in front. Place Gangplank E Powder Keg beside where the enemy will stand, then detonate it from behind with Gangplank Q Parrrley. Layer Gangplank R Cannon Barrage to keep them slowed and block their escape route. When going in directly, wait until key disruption effects such as the tornado from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest are down.
